metadata.title: NitiSetu Dynamic Scheme Matching Rules
metadata.rule_evaluation_logic: All specified conditions for a scheme must evaluate to TRUE for citizen eligibility.

flagship_scheme_rules.benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly via DBT.
exclusions: Farmer families where any member holds or held constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons
Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Govt Ministries, Departments, PSEs, Attached offices
All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000 or more (excluding MTS/Class IV/Group D)
All persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, Architects

flagship_scheme_rules.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
flagship_scheme_rules.benefit_summary: Cashless health insurance cover of ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
exclusions: Households owning motorized 2/3/4-wheeler or mechanized fishing boat
Households possessing Kisan Credit Card with credit limit of ₹50,000 or more
Household with government employees or income tax payers
Households with pucca houses with more than 3 rooms

flagship_scheme_rules.benefit_summary: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹1,200/month) for higher education.

Free PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 e-voucher toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest.
exclusions: Persons who have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra in past 5 years and have outstanding balance
Only one member per family eligible

flagship_scheme_rules.scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
flagship_scheme_rules.benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche ₹10,000 (1 year), 2nd tranche ₹20,000, 3rd tranche ₹50,000. 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.

flagship_scheme_rules.scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
flagship_scheme_rules.benefit_summary: Direct capital subsidy for residential rooftop solar: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above. Provides up to 300 units free electricity per month.
High government interest rate (8.2% p.a.), exempt under 80C, tax-free interest and maturity corpus for daughter's education and marriage.
